description: The home page's verse of the day: one of these each day, in turn (the day's number since 1970, in the reader's time zone, modulo their count), taken from those already translated into the page's language, so it is never shown in another. Verse ids are numbered as in the source text, so the Psalms count a title as verse 1; the list keeps to psalm verses whose number is the same in English Bibles. Each must be a whole sentence or end one, in a chapter already drafted; tests/test_site.py checks.
